facts.subject: Tray unavailable error code
facts.value: ERR_TRAY_UNAVAILABLE — emitted when no system tray is present; app must degrade gracefully without orphaning a resident process

facts.subject: Notification permission denied error code
facts.value: ERR_NOTIFICATION_DENIED — OS notification permission denied; no error loop, session state remains visible on manual restore

facts.subject: Host subprocess start failure error code
facts.value: ERR_HOST_START_FAILED — shell stays alive, enters failed state, troubleshooting guidance shown in-app (UF4)

facts.subject: Update feed unreachable error code
facts.value: ERR_UPDATE_FEED_UNREACHABLE — update check fails silently; no error dialog, no retry storm, startup not blocked

facts.subject: Non-whitelisted release URL rejection
facts.value: ERR_UPDATE_URL_REJECTED — openExternal rejected for URLs outside RELEASE_HOST allowlist; rejection logged; app continues normally

facts.subject: Single instance lock error code
facts.value: ERR_SINGLE_INSTANCE — second launch routed to running instance: window open → focus existing; tray-resident → restore from tray; no second host subprocess

facts.subject: Notification dedup window
facts.value: DEDUP_WINDOW_MS = 10000 — same session + same event type within 10s merges into one notification updated with latest content; click still focuses that session

facts.subject: Crash recovery backoff and terminal state
facts.value: BACKOFF_SCHEDULE_MS = [2000, 4000, 8000]; 3 attempts; exhaustion → failed state with failure code retry-exhausted (ERR_RECOVERY_RETRY_EXHAUSTED-shaped message, ≤120-char failure detail); no infinite retry, shell stays alive

facts.subject: Release URL allowlist
facts.value: RELEASE_HOST = 'github.com', RELEASE_PATH_PREFIX = '/bigfaner/dsh-forge/releases'; only matching URLs may open externally

facts.subject: Update banner state machine
facts.value: UpdateBannerPhase = hidden | queued | shown | dismissed; while UF4 recovery mask active a new banner transitions to queued and is shown when mask exits; already-shown banner stays shown under mask; dismissed is terminal until restart

facts.subject: Carrier protocol
facts.value: dsh-app:// custom protocol carries the upstream SPA; no listening port is opened

facts.subject: Shell IPC channel namespaces
facts.value: dshForge.update.* and dshForge.recovery.* IPC channels with sender validation (ERR_IPC_SENDER_REJECTED on invalid sender)

facts.subject: Profile directory isolation
facts.value: dsh-forge profile directory is independent of upstream desktop profile; shared $DSH_HOME product data read/written only in upstream existing format

facts.subject: i18n locale mechanism
facts.value: Shell-layer tray/notification/banner texts resolved via upstream locale mechanism (zh/en) through t() CopyKeys; zero hardcoded strings; switching upstream locale changes tray and notification texts

facts.subject: Vendored upstream lock baseline
facts.value: vendor/upstream.lock.json: pinnedSha c36ba648dc106d21fb32562793b3e3b9c8922bc4, desktopHostVersion 0.1.6-alpha.2, @deepseek-ai/cordis 4.0.2 — the alignment baseline every plugin version assertion reads

facts.subject: Product-level plugin bundle config (plugin tree single source of truth)
facts.value: apps/desktop/resources/plugin-bundles.json lists bundles: @deepseek-ai/dsh-base, @deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app, @dsh-forge/plugin-hello-world with source "tarball:plugin-tarballs/dsh-forge-plugin-hello-world-0.1.0.tgz"; loaded once at startup, read-only to the shell module (runtime enable/disable writers must not mutate product-owned entries)

facts.subject: Startup reconciliation of userData profile to product config
facts.value: add leg: profile bundle manifest rewritten to config order, entries carrying a source get profile-local materialization seeded; delete leg: entries the config dropped are pruned from the manifest and their profile-local materialization removed; upstream-owned .dsh-module-fallback/ links never touched; cleanup only invalidates — never adds an assembly channel

facts.subject: Bundle materialization source vocabulary and write-once pre-seed marker
facts.value: source forms: workspace:<repo-relative dir> (dev junction, source dir must exist) and tarball:<resources-relative .tgz> (packaged: shell unpacks pnpm-pack artifact into profile node_modules as a real directory — no pnpm, no network; seed marker .dsh-forge-seed.json carries artifact sha256, re-runs idempotent, sha drift converges)

facts.subject: Vendored host boot argv contract
facts.value: argv[2] runtimeDir = dsh installation dir whose node_modules carries the install anchor; argv[3] projectDir = profile project with package.json dsh.profile.bundles manifest (host materializes own node_modules link-mode fallback junctions on first boot); argv[4] source = primary-runtime payload dir whose sibling office-skills/ is a hard boot requirement

facts.subject: userData projection paths (SC8 coexistence)
facts.value: shell projects app-owned inputs under <userData>/host-profile and <userData>/host-payload — never inside the upstream $DSH_HOME; runProfile with resolvedProfile writes only into the handed profile dir

facts.subject: hello-world plugin manifest
facts.value: @dsh-forge/plugin-hello-world: exports["./client"] exposed; dsh.client.inject = @deepseek-ai/dsh-client-locale, ui-chat, ui-renderer (minimal stable subset); every @deepseek-ai/dsh-client-* peer+dev dep exact 0.1.6-alpha.2; cordis peer 4.0.2 exact; platform web

facts.subject: hello-world slot contract (two-way extension)
facts.value: injects into conversation.chat.assistant-actions (ui-chat core strip); registers hello-world.panel sub-slot {kind single, scope session} plus a store seat (createHelloWorldStore) through the same ctx.slots.register call; panel click updates the store seat and re-renders — the run-link evidence that distinguishes live link from static injection

facts.subject: Collision fixture build-time modes (ui-slots collision mechanics)
facts.value: hello-world-collision MODE: replica = same child key hello-world.panel distinct id, first declarer wins and second register call throws; coexist = own key collision-replica.panel, both panels merge into the list slot (control); shadow = same cell id at lower priority -1, layered takeover with previous occupant staying on the ledger; tie = same cell id at same priority 0, registry rejects with an explicit throw

facts.subject: Version-consistency gate comparison set
facts.value: scripts/verify-plugins.mjs: alignment line = every @deepseek-ai/dsh-client-* dependency in dependencies/devDependencies/peerDependencies/optionalDependencies must be an exact pinned version identical to UpstreamLock.desktopHostVersion (dist-tags must be resolved and committed as exact first); independent line = @deepseek-ai/cordis exact but deliberately NOT compared with desktopHostVersion; everything else out of the set; entry forms: vitest tests/verify-plugins.spec.ts (runs inside pnpm test) and CLI pnpm verify:plugins; --stamp stamps template version stamps

facts.subject: Artifact-level vendored scan and template manifest rules
facts.value: plugin build artifacts under lib/ (.js/.mjs/.cjs) must be vendor-free: any module specifier resolving into vendor trees (vendor/ or packages/desktop-host-vendor/), carrying a vendor path segment, or using file: protocol into the repo is red; manifest dependency specs declaring file:/link:/workspace: or bare in-repo paths are red for the same reason; templates expect no built lib/ but face the same manifest rules, MUST carry version-stamp.json, and MUST declare engines["@deepseek-ai/dsh"] exact == desktopHostVersion

facts.subject: Plugin engineering template manifest
facts.value: @dsh-forge/template-plugin (packages/templates/plugin): engines {"@deepseek-ai/dsh": "0.1.6-alpha.2"} (VS Code engines.vscode analog), exports["./client"], npm-form exact dependencies (no workspace:/link:/file: specs), dsh.client.inject = minimal stable subset (locale, ui-chat, ui-renderer)

facts.subject: Plugin tarball staging (packaging leg, config-driven)
facts.value: scripts/stage-plugin-tarballs.mjs: pnpm-pack the workspace plugins the product config references via tarball: sources and stage artifacts next to plugin-bundles.json in app resources (dev: apps/desktop/resources; packaged: electron-builder extraResources filter plugin-tarballs/**); staged filename must equal the config-declared basename — plugin version bump without config edit fails loud; --check verifies staged files exist; exit 0 success / 1 failure

facts.subject: live-ui-probe real-chain evidence collection flags
facts.value: scripts/acceptance/live-ui-probe.mjs runs the real vendored host subprocess + real web dist; --plugin-leg collects boot roster product plugin entries, [data-dsh-forge-plugin] panel DOM text, panel-only screenshots, and click -> store update -> re-render live check; --executable probes the packaged exe (win-unpacked); --offline-proxy attaches dead proxy 127.0.0.1:9 (all external HTTP fails = offline simulation; dsh-app:// custom protocol bypasses proxy); --artifacts-dir defaults to docs/features/ui-plugin-foundation/artifacts; exit 0 = probe completed, 1 = boot/UI wait failure

facts.subject: Spike report gate for M2 design
facts.value: docs/features/ui-plugin-foundation/spike-report.md: each of the three unverified items archived as conclusion + independent fallback two-column; distribution-form conclusion (spike-report §4.1) = tarball built-in + shell-side pre-seeding; source-level facts anchored to checkout SHA c36ba648 (0.1.6-alpha.2); journey pins the doc reference baseline at tech-direction commit 6f5b109 (2026-09-21)

facts.subject: Workbench IPC verb face channel inventory
facts.value: 16 whitelisted channels under dshForge.workbench.*: getState, registerProject, updateProject, removeProject, activateProject, getTaskBoard, getTaskDetail, getFeatureBoard, readFeatureDoc, listPlugins, setPluginEnabled, recordSessionLink, endSessionLink, authorizeExternalDocPath, plus subscribeEvents/unsubscribeEvents; one channel per verb, sender validation before service call

facts.subject: Workbench IPC error envelope
facts.value: WorkbenchErrorEnvelope {code, message, detail?}; reject serializes the envelope as the Error message (renderer parses back to object); errors carrying a domain ERR_* code pass through unchanged; unclassified exceptions fall back to ERR_WORKBENCH_DB with log

facts.subject: TaskSummary DTO dialect
facts.value: TaskSummary.key = qualified board address <featureSlug>/<localId>; blockers = same-feature local upstream keys (transitive chain expanded by getTaskDetail); branch nullable execution trace; worktree boolean; source = session|terminal|null; updatedAt timestamp

facts.subject: Task status vocabulary (7 states)
facts.value: task_snapshot.status constrained to pending, in_progress, completed, blocked, suspended, skipped, rejected; source column constrained to session or terminal; blockers stored as JSON array of direct upstream keys

facts.subject: Feature snapshot projection
facts.value: feature_snapshot.status is a manifest-vocabulary passthrough (prd/design/tasks/in-progress/completed); doc_kinds = JSON array subset of manifest/prd/design/ui/tasks; task_total and task_completed counts maintained per feature

facts.subject: Session link lifecycle semantics
facts.value: session_links UNIQUE(project_id, task_key, session_id); status active|ended; recordSessionLink = idempotent upsert (re-record refreshes started_at, resets to active, row id stable); endSessionLink sets ended without deleting rows (idempotent no-op when already ended); supersedeActiveSessionLinks ends other active rows of the same task keeping the keepSessionId row (launch-side convergence; no convergence at app exit); history listed newest-first by started_at including ended rows

facts.subject: Project registration repo semantics
facts.value: projects.code_root UNIQUE -> ERR_PROJECT_EXISTS on duplicate; display_name defaults to the code_root directory name when not provided; doc_location_type in_repo (path NULL) | external (path required); removeProject runs in an immediate transaction that clears the active_project_id pointer when it targets the removed project, with CASCADE deleting snapshots and session links; unknown id -> ERR_PROJECT_NOT_FOUND

facts.subject: Registration/repoint validation chain order and codes
facts.value: Chain order (rejection precedence): (1) input coherence shape errors -> plain Error; (2) code_root not a readable directory -> ERR_CODE_ROOT_UNREADABLE (message carries path and reason: does not exist / permission denied / not a directory); (3) external path equals own code_root, an existing project code_root, or an existing external doc path -> ERR_DOC_PATH_CONFLICT (pure db comparison, zero fs); (4) external path without recorded authorization -> ERR_EXTERNAL_PATH_UNREADABLE (checked before any fs probe of that path); (5) external path not readable -> ERR_EXTERNAL_PATH_UNREADABLE; (6) forge data not detected -> ERR_FORGE_NOT_DETECTED; (7) repos UNIQUE(code_root) -> ERR_PROJECT_EXISTS. updateProject repoint walks the same chain (edit mode has no authorization exemption); pure rename does no fs probing

facts.subject: Forge checkout detection rule
facts.value: forge data detected when a .forge directory or a docs/features directory exists under the effective doc location (in_repo -> codeRoot; external -> docLocationPath); the ERR_FORGE_NOT_DETECTED message names which probe is missing

facts.subject: getTaskPrompt probe gates and spawn shape
facts.value: Gate order: illegal task-key dialect -> ERR_NO_PROMPT with no spawn; projectRoot not in the registered-project allowlist -> ERR_NO_PROMPT; CLI resolution failure or spawn error -> ERR_FORGE_CLI_UNAVAILABLE; otherwise spawns 'forge prompt get-by-task-id <localId>' with cwd pinned to the registered root, 15s budget, 2MiB stdout cap, 256KiB stderr cap; nonzero exit (structured stderr), timeout, output overflow, or empty stdout -> ERR_NO_PROMPT; success returns the COMPLETE stdout untrimmed (promptText is byte-faithful)

facts.subject: Task key dialects
facts.value: local forge task id = digits separated by dots (source whitelist FORGE_TASK_KEY_PATTERN); board-qualified address = <featureSlug>/<localId> (used in IPC and session_links); spawn argv carries only the local id

facts.subject: SessionLaunch host chain contract
facts.value: launch input {promptText (complete getTaskPrompt stdout), title, cwd = registered codeRoot, sessionId?}; channel = in-process sessionController: create({sessionId, cwd}) idempotent-adopts a caller-minted session-<uuid> id, then prompt({requestId, sessionId, mode: 'queue', content}) persists the first user message; requestId deterministically derived by sha256 over sessionId + message (replays never double-post); failure reasonCodes: ERR_HOST_NOT_READY (channel absent; client tries tier 2) and ERR_SESSION_CHANNEL_UNAVAILABLE (create/prompt leg failed or exceeded the 10s per-leg hang guard; routes into the tier-3 fallback, never an error presentation); empty promptText or cwd is a caller contract rejection

facts.subject: UF5 launch degradation chain tiers
facts.value: tier 1 host channel -> tier 2 renderer ctx.remote.session retry (carries the tier-1 recovery sessionId for adopt + re-prompt) -> tier 3 frozen fallback (verbatim prompt to clipboard + main window fronted + manual-guidance toast); channel failures ROUTE down the chain and are never displayed as errors; only a denied clipboard or a thrown rejection resolves 'failed' (LaunchErrorDialog with clipboard-denied/unexpected copy and a retry entry)

facts.subject: UF5 entry probe and stage states
facts.value: mount-once getTaskPrompt probe: available -> trigger enabled with the byte-faithful cached promptText; ERR_NO_PROMPT or ERR_FORGE_CLI_UNAVAILABLE -> trigger disabled with a reason tooltip (launch.reason.noPrompt = 该任务没有执行 prompt,无法从它发起会话 / launch.reason.cliUnavailable), never an error surface; confirm panel shows the prompt preview default-collapsed with confirm as default focus (one click, 3s budget); trigger element carries data-probe and data-stage attributes; stages idle/confirm/degraded/failed/done; initiating indicator while the chain runs

facts.subject: Launch success-leg persistence order
facts.value: after a launched outcome: recordSessionLink({projectId, taskKey = qualified address, sessionId}) — a persistence hiccup is swallowed (the session is not un-launched); then onLaunched switches to the session view (uiWorkspace.openSession) and the task card shows the 会话运行中 badge; the launch-side supersede converges prior active links of the task

facts.subject: FORGE_ACTOR attribution and change-source determination
facts.value: first user message = verbatim prompt + ONE appended attribution instruction line (body never rewritten), actor value 'session:<sessionId>'; change-source order: path 1 record actor frontmatter 'session:' prefix -> session / literal 'terminal' -> terminal; path 2 fallback: task has an active session link -> session, otherwise terminal; judged only for changed rows (unchanged rows keep historical source)

facts.subject: WorkbenchEvent push shapes
facts.value: WorkbenchEvent = task_updated {projectId, taskKey, source, changeKind attribute|structural} | feature_updated {projectId, featureSlug} | sync {projectId, sync}; SyncStatusPayload = {state idle|scanning|error, lastScanAt, error?}; batched push on channel dsh-forge:workbench-events to subscribed live senders only; single-subscriber semantics per webContents (re-subscribe idempotent, destroy auto-unsubscribes)

facts.subject: File watcher orchestration budgets
facts.value: watch targets = codeRoot/.forge plus the effective docs/features (external doc location -> docLocationPath/docs/features); change batches debounced 400ms trailing; rescans scheduled via setTimeout(0) macro-task slicing (never on the fs callback stack); event batcher merges pushes within 500ms; only registered and authorized roots are watched (unauthorized external root excluded with a warn, other roots unaffected); activate switch = full watch rebuild (handles released); removeProject stops the chain with null

facts.subject: Plugin two-tier runtime projection
facts.value: PluginRow {name, mandatory, enabled}; mandatory derives from the build-time product manifest plugin-bundles.json (runtime read-only); enabled derives from <userData>/plugin-runtime.json whose schema is exactly {disabled: string[]} — a missing file is an empty overlay meaning all enabled; the overlay structurally excludes mandatory names (third-party only)

facts.subject: setPluginEnabled guard behavior
facts.value: guard runs before any overlay write: disable request for a mandatory bundle -> PluginMandatoryError with code ERR_PLUGIN_MANDATORY plus a structured log (UI renders no disable affordance = defense layer 1; the guard is layer 2); unknown plugin name -> plain contract error from the verb face; a successful write touches ONLY the overlay file (manifest bytes unchanged) and returns the refreshed PluginRow list

facts.subject: Plugin runtime overlay parse-time validation
facts.value: structurally malformed overlay (bad JSON, non-object root, unknown keys, missing/non-array disabled) -> original isolated as <name>.corrupt-<timestamp> and an empty overlay rebuilt, startup never blocked, ERR_PLUGIN_RUNTIME_STATE logged; schema-valid but violating entries (mandatory names, unknown names, non-strings) stripped in memory with an ERR_PLUGIN_RUNTIME_STATE log — the manifest state wins for those rows

facts.subject: External doc path authorization gate
facts.value: the authorizeExternalDocPath verb is the sole persistence channel for wizard step-2 explicit authorization; the validation chain checks the authorization record BEFORE any fs probe of the path (unauthorized external path -> ERR_EXTERNAL_PATH_UNREADABLE without probing); repoint/edit mode walks the same chain with no exemption

facts.subject: Source marking and link UI labels (zh locale)
facts.value: tasks.source.session = 会话; tasks.source.terminal = 终端; tasks.badge.sessionLive = 会话运行中; detail.links.active = 会话中; detail.links.enter = 进入会话; detail.links.empty = 该任务尚未挂接会话; launch.reason.noPrompt tooltip = 该任务没有执行 prompt,无法从它发起会话

facts.subject: View-key page addressing (no URL routes)
facts.value: no URL routing; pages addressed by session-memory view keys: workbench/overview (default tab), workbench/tasks, workbench/features (+ :slug detail subview), workbench/dialog/* overlays (wizard, remove confirm, plugin disable confirm, launch error), session (upstream view, UF5 jump target); equivalent gating = state gates (no active project -> overview empty state auto-enters wizard; invalid external doc -> error card + repoint guidance)

facts.subject: readFeatureDoc kind whitelist and tab gating
facts.value: readFeatureDoc kind must be one of manifest/prd/design/ui/tasks (shape error otherwise); FeatureSummary.docKinds lists only the kinds actually present and drives the UF4 doc-tab enabled/disabled state — missing kinds render disabled, never hidden; the five tab headers are always present

facts.subject: TaskDetail composition
facts.value: getTaskDetail returns summary + descriptionMarkdown (task file raw markdown for injection-safe read-only rendering) + depChain (transitive upstream blocker chain, topological order, qualified keys) + records (at/kind/source/summary adapted from the forge write-once record markdown, no fabricated fields) + links (session link history newest-first, ended rows included); per-task link history is the same lookup the source-inference fallback consumes

facts.subject: Sync status surface on the board
facts.value: TaskBoardData carries sync SyncStatusPayload {state idle|scanning|error, lastScanAt, error?}; sync_state.error caps the reason at 120 characters; on perception-chain failure the board presents the sync-error toolbar indication with silent retry and retains the last-good board; snapshots are rebuildable derived caches (forge files remain the sole source of truth)
